Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly constrained searches to the wrong domain (truthinscience.org) for the UK-based “Truth in Science,” which actually uses truthinscience.org.uk. This mis-specified site restriction led to repeated, non-progressive searches with no results and ignored evidence from general results indicating the correct domain and the shared “Teach the Controversy” campaign.
